title: Every Component Counts: Rethinking the Measure of Success for Medical Semantic Segmentation in Multi-Instance Segmentation Tasks (CC-Metrics)
mechanism: Evaluates Dice / surface Dice per GT component on its Voronoi cell and averages, removing the large-component bias; proximity-based matching.
adaptation: Benchmark metric: per-instance crack Dice and per-instance relF1@2 on merged crack instances, plus size-stratified recall (< 20 px, >= 20 px) for test and E1.
min_experiment: Compute CC-Dice on val/F51 predictions of house vs ensemble vs PF; check rank agreement with relF1@2. Kill as a headline metric if rank correlation > 0.95 with relF1@2 (adds no information).
evidence: Whole-body PET/CT metastases: standard metrics biased to large components; CC-Metrics fixes Dice and HD sensitivity to small lesions.
